annotations.title: TIA — Project Server projects and locks

description: Lists the projects of a Project Server with their lock state: every project of the server, or only those of `group` (matched like `server`). A page is {server, group, projects:[{projectName, serverAlias, lockState:{isLocked, owner, error}}], total, nextCursor}; the lock state is read for the projects of the returned page only, a failed lock read gives isLocked:null with the reason in error instead of failing the call, and owner is null when the project is not locked. For a large server read it in pages: pass limit (1-1000), then pass the nextCursor of each page as cursor until nextCursor is null; total is the number of projects of the whole list. Without limit and cursor the whole list is returned. An unknown name is 404 not_found (details.available lists the names that work), a name that matches several is 409 ambiguous_name (details.matches), and a Project Server that is unreachable or refuses the Windows user of the serve is 502 project_server_error (details.server, operation, type, message). Needs a running TIA Portal on the serve host (tia_start) but no open project. Maps to GET /multiuser/servers/{server}/projects?group=&limit=&cursor= (the last three optional). Read-only (class R).

cursor.description: the nextCursor of the previous page, passed back exactly as received; it is opaque, so never invent, build or edit one (omit it for the first page, and omit both limit and cursor for the whole list)

group.description: project group name (from tia_project_server_groups); omit for every project of the server

limit.description: page size, an integer from 1 to 1000; pass it to read the list in pages (omit both limit and cursor for the whole list)
